$comment: The packs this repository generates components for. Each is read from git at the pinned commit `ref` (a full SHA, never a branch), from the sibling checkout `checkout` when it holds that commit, else by a shallow fetch of `repository`. Adding a pack is a new entry here; moving a pack forward is a new `ref`. `minIcons` is the floor the count guard enforces, set a little under the measured count.
